text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding language, recognizing images, or making decisions. Machine learning is a key part of AI: instead of following fixed rules, computers learn from data and improve with experience. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses large artificial neural networks to find patterns in huge amounts of information. AI is already part of daily life. It helps power search engines, voice assistants, recommendation systems, and translation apps. It also supports doctors in diagnosis and helps companies work more efficiently.
